---
title: "Sleep & Physical Strength — CDC NHANES 2011–2014"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(survey)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)

# 1. Load preserved 10,987-participant analytical dataset (unmodified)
df <- read_rds("data/processed/nhanes_sleep_strength.rds")

# 2. Construct CDC/NCHS complex multistage survey design on full MEC universe
#    Cycle G (2011-2012, strata 90-103) + Cycle H (2013-2014, strata 104-118):
#    29 non-overlapping strata, 61 PSUs, 32 design degrees of freedom
demo_mec <- bind_rows(
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_G.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR),
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_H.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR)
) |>
  filter(WTMEC2YR > 0) |>
  mutate(mec_weight_4yr = WTMEC2YR / 2) |>
  left_join(
    df |> select(-mec_weight_4yr) |> mutate(in_cohort = TRUE),
    by = "SEQN"
  ) |>
  mutate(in_cohort = coalesce(in_cohort, FALSE))

des_mec_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~mec_weight_4yr,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = demo_mec
)

des_analytic <- subset(des_mec_full, in_cohort)
n_strata <- length(unique(df |> left_join(demo_mec |> select(SEQN, SDMVSTRA), by = "SEQN") |> pull(SDMVSTRA)))
n_degf <- as.integer(degf(des_analytic))

# 3. Reproducible hero & headline summary statistics (Unweighted vs Survey-Weighted)
n_total <- nrow(df)
n_male <- sum(df$sex == "Male")
n_female <- sum(df$sex == "Female")

unw_mean_sleep <- round(mean(df$sleep_hours), 2)
unw_pct_rec <- round(mean(df$sleep_hours %in% c(7, 8)) * 100, 1)
unw_pooled_med <- round(median(df$combined_grip_kg), 1)
unw_med_m <- round(median(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Male"]), 1)
unw_med_f <- round(median(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Female"]), 1)
unw_sex_gap_med <- round(unw_med_m - unw_med_f, 1)

svy_means <- svymean(~sleep_hours + combined_grip_kg, des_analytic)
wtd_mean_sleep <- round(as.numeric(coef(svymeans_s <- svy_means)["sleep_hours"]), 2)
svy_sex_meds <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex, des_analytic,
  svyquantile, quantiles = 0.5, ci = TRUE, vartype = "ci"
)
wtd_med_m <- round(svy_sex_meds$combined_grip_kg[svy_sex_meds$sex == "Male"], 1)
wtd_med_f <- round(svy_sex_meds$combined_grip_kg[svy_sex_meds$sex == "Female"], 1)
wtd_sex_gap_med <- round(wtd_med_m - wtd_med_f, 1)

# Age-group counts for interactive filter pills
age_counts <- df |>
  count(age_group) |>
  deframe()

# 4. Exact distribution-free order-statistic 95% CI helper for unweighted sample medians
exact_median_ci <- \(x, conf = 0.95) {
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3L) return(tibble(med = median(x), lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_))
  k <- qbinom((1 - conf) / 2, size = n, prob = 0.5)
  lo_idx <- max(1L, k)
  hi_idx <- min(n, n - k + 1L)
  tibble(
    med = round(median(x), 1),
    lo = round(x[lo_idx], 1),
    hi = round(x[hi_idx], 1)
  )
}

cat_levels <- levels(df$sleep_category)

# Unweighted discrete medians & 95% CIs (All Ages + 5 Age Groups)
unw_all <- df |>
  group_by(sex, sleep_category) |>
  reframe(n = n(), exact_median_ci(combined_grip_kg)) |>
  mutate(age_slice = "ALL")

unw_by_age <- df |>
  group_by(age_group, sex, sleep_category) |>
  reframe(n = n(), exact_median_ci(combined_grip_kg)) |>
  mutate(age_slice = as.character(age_group)) |>
  select(-age_group)

unw_summary <- bind_rows(unw_all, unw_by_age) |>
  mutate(cat_idx = match(as.character(sleep_category), cat_levels) - 1L) |>
  arrange(age_slice, sex, cat_idx)

# Survey-weighted discrete medians & design-based 95% CIs (All Ages + 5 Age Groups)
svy_all_raw <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex + sleep_category, des_analytic,
  svyquantile, quantiles = 0.5, ci = TRUE, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(
    age_slice = "ALL",
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    sleep_category = factor(sleep_category, levels = cat_levels),
    w_med = round(combined_grip_kg, 1),
    w_lo = round(ci_l, 1),
    w_hi = round(ci_u, 1)
  )

svy_age_raw <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~age_group + sex + sleep_category, des_analytic,
  svyquantile, quantiles = 0.5, ci = TRUE, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(
    age_slice = as.character(age_group),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    sleep_category = factor(sleep_category, levels = cat_levels),
    w_med = round(combined_grip_kg, 1),
    w_lo = round(ci_l, 1),
    w_hi = round(ci_u, 1)
  )

combined_summary <- unw_summary |>
  left_join(
    bind_rows(svy_all_raw, svy_age_raw),
    by = c("age_slice", "sex", "sleep_category")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sex = as.character(sex),
    sleep_category = as.character(sleep_category)
  )

# Overall sex-level medians per age slice for panel headers
panel_medians_unw <- bind_rows(
  df |> group_by(sex) |> summarise(n_sex = n(), med_sex = round(median(combined_grip_kg), 1), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(age_slice = "ALL"),
  df |> group_by(age_group, sex) |> summarise(n_sex = n(), med_sex = round(median(combined_grip_kg), 1), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(age_slice = as.character(age_group)) |> select(-age_group)
)

svy_panel_all <- svyby(~combined_grip_kg, ~sex, des_analytic, svyquantile, quantiles = 0.5, ci = TRUE, vartype = "ci") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(age_slice = "ALL", sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")), w_med_sex = round(combined_grip_kg, 1))

svy_panel_age <- svyby(~combined_grip_kg, ~age_group + sex, des_analytic, svyquantile, quantiles = 0.5, ci = TRUE, vartype = "ci") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(age_slice = as.character(age_group), sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")), w_med_sex = round(combined_grip_kg, 1))

panel_headers <- panel_medians_unw |>
  left_join(bind_rows(svy_panel_all, svy_panel_age), by = c("age_slice", "sex")) |>
  mutate(sex = as.character(sex))

# Headline range check across <=5h, 6h, and 7-8h to populate finding-oriented title reproducibly
fmt1 <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
m_5to8 <- combined_summary |> filter(age_slice == "ALL", sex == "Male", cat_idx %in% 0:2)
f_5to8 <- combined_summary |> filter(age_slice == "ALL", sex == "Female", cat_idx %in% 0:2)
m_5to8_range <- paste0(fmt1(min(m_5to8$med)), "–", fmt1(max(m_5to8$med)), " kg")
f_5to8_range <- paste0(fmt1(min(f_5to8$med)), "–", fmt1(max(f_5to8$med)), " kg")
m_9plus_med <- fmt1(combined_summary |> filter(age_slice == "ALL", sex == "Male", cat_idx == 3) |> pull(med))
f_9plus_med <- fmt1(combined_summary |> filter(age_slice == "ALL", sex == "Female", cat_idx == 3) |> pull(med))

# 5. Density-scaled ("violin-proportioned") jitter for all 10,987 observations
#    Spreads points wider where grip-strength density is highest to minimize overplotting
density_jitter_vec <- \(y_vals, max_half_width = 0.33) {
  n_pts <- length(y_vals)
  if (n_pts <= 2L) return(runif(n_pts, -0.08, 0.08))
  dens <- density(y_vals, n = 128)
  rel_d <- approx(dens$x, dens$y, xout = y_vals, rule = 2)$y
  rel_d <- rel_d / max(rel_d)
  runif(n_pts, -1, 1) * rel_d * max_half_width
}

set.seed(2026)
pts_prepared <- df |>
  mutate(cat_idx = match(as.character(sleep_category), cat_levels) - 1L) |>
  group_by(sex, sleep_category) |>
  mutate(x_all = round(cat_idx + density_jitter_vec(combined_grip_kg, 0.34), 3)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(age_group, sex, sleep_category) |>
  mutate(x_age = round(cat_idx + density_jitter_vec(combined_grip_kg, 0.32), 3)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    s = if_else(sex == "Male", 0L, 1L),
    ag = as.character(age_group),
    c = cat_idx,
    xa = x_all,
    xg = x_age,
    y = round(combined_grip_kg, 1),
    h = as.integer(sleep_hours),
    age = as.integer(age)
  )

homepage_json <- toJSON(
  list(
    points = pts_prepared,
    summaries = combined_summary,
    headers = panel_headers
  ),
  dataframe = "columns",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

dep_widget <- plot_ly() |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }")
```

<div class="platform-shell">

<!-- HERO SECTION -->
<section class="hero-section">
<div class="eyebrow-badge">
CDC NHANES 2011–2014 &middot; N = `r comma(n_total)` Individual Examinees &middot; Ages 16 to 80+
</div>
<h1 class="hero-title">
From Athletic Recovery to <span class="gradient-text">Lifelong Physical Strength</span>
</h1>
<p class="hero-subtitle">
Motivated by exercise-recovery research on sleep and physical performance (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Craven et al., 2022</a>) alongside clinical sleep guidelines (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Watson et al., 2015</a>), this empirical investigation examines all <strong>`r comma(n_total)` U.S. adolescents, working-age adults, and older adults</strong> with complete sleep and bilateral handgrip dynamometry in CDC NHANES 2011–2014—testing how habitual weekday sleep duration aligns with objective upper-body strength across biological sex and the human lifespan.
</p>

<div class="rq-callout">
<div class="rq-label">Central Research Question &amp; Empirical Scope</div>
<p class="rq-question">
How is nightly sleep duration associated with objective physical strength, and how do biological sex and lifespan aging shape that relationship?
</p>
<p class="rq-note">
<strong>Methodological distinction:</strong> NHANES is a cross-sectional complex probability survey (`r n_strata` strata, 61 primary sampling units, `r n_degf` design df). Throughout this site, raw participant point clouds (`N = 10,987`) and unweighted sample statistics are explicitly distinguished from age-adjusted and MEC survey-weighted U.S. population estimates.
</p>
</div>
</section>

<div class="finding-note" id="home-finding-callout">
<strong>Why separating sex and checking age matters:</strong> Pooling men and women places a single overall sample median (`r fmt1(unw_pooled_med)` kg) in the low-density gap between male (`r fmt1(unw_med_m)` kg sample; `r fmt1(wtd_med_m)` kg survey-weighted) and female (`r fmt1(unw_med_f)` kg sample; `r fmt1(wtd_med_f)` kg survey-weighted) distributions (`r fmt1(wtd_sex_gap_med)` kg survey-weighted median gap). Within each sex, short (`&le;5h`, `6h`) and recommended (`7–8h`) sleepers exhibit nearly identical median grip strength. Although `9+h` sleepers show lower unadjusted sample medians (`r m_9plus_med` kg Male, `r f_9plus_med` kg Female), clicking through the <strong>Life-Stage Filter</strong> above shows that `9+h` sleepers aged `16–29` and `30–44` match `7–8h` peers closely—the lower strength among `9+h` sleepers concentrates in older adulthood (`60–74` and `75–80+`).
</div>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const PTS = HOME_DATA.points;
  const SUM = HOME_DATA.summaries;
  const HDR = HOME_DATA.headers;
  const TOTAL_N = PTS.y.length;

  const SHORT_CATS = ["≤5h Very Short", "6h Short", "7–8h Recommended", "9+h Long"];
  const FULL_CATS = [
    "Very Short (<=5h)",
    "Short (6h)",
    "Recommended (7-8h)",
    "Long (9+h)"
  ];

  let activeAge = "ALL";
  let activeEst = "unweighted";

  function getSummaryRows(ageSlice, sexName) {
    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < SUM.age_slice.length; i++) {
      if (SUM.age_slice[i] === ageSlice && SUM.sex[i] === sexName) {
        rows.push({
          catIdx: SUM.cat_idx[i],
          catName: SUM.sleep_category[i],
          n: SUM.n[i],
          med: activeEst === "unweighted" ? SUM.med[i] : SUM.w_med[i],
          lo: activeEst === "unweighted" ? SUM.lo[i] : SUM.w_lo[i],
          hi: activeEst === "unweighted" ? SUM.hi[i] : SUM.w_hi[i],
          unwMed: SUM.med[i],
          wtdMed: SUM.w_med[i]
        });
      }
    }
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.catIdx - b.catIdx);
    return rows;
  }

  function getHeaderStat(ageSlice, sexName) {
    for (let i = 0; i < HDR.age_slice.length; i++) {
      if (HDR.age_slice[i] === ageSlice && HDR.sex[i] === sexName) {
        return {
          n: HDR.n_sex[i],
          med: activeEst === "unweighted" ? HDR.med_sex[i] : HDR.w_med_sex[i]
        };
      }
    }
    return { n: 0, med: 0 };
  }

  function buildPanelTraces(sexCode, sexName, colorHex, axisSuffix) {
    const xArr = [];
    const yArr = [];
    const customArr = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < TOTAL_N; i++) {
      if (PTS.s[i] !== sexCode) continue;
      if (activeAge !== "ALL" && PTS.ag[i] !== activeAge) continue;
      xArr.push(activeAge === "ALL" ? PTS.xa[i] : PTS.xg[i]);
      yArr.push(PTS.y[i]);
      customArr.push([PTS.h[i], PTS.age[i], FULL_CATS[PTS.c[i]]]);
    }

    const ptOpacity = activeAge === "ALL" ? 0.22 : 0.40;
    const ptSize = activeAge === "ALL" ? 3.8 : 4.8;

    const cloudTrace = {
      type: "scattergl",
      mode: "markers",
      name: sexName + " Participants (n = " + xArr.length.toLocaleString() + ")",
      xaxis: "x" + axisSuffix,
      yaxis: "y" + axisSuffix,
      x: xArr,
      y: yArr,
      customdata: customArr,
      marker: {
        size: ptSize,
        opacity: ptOpacity,
        color: colorHex
      },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>" + sexName + " Participant</b><br>" +
        "Combined Grip: <b>%{y:.1f} kg</b><br>" +
        "Reported Sleep: <b>%{customdata[0]} hrs/night</b> (%{customdata[2]})<br>" +
        "Age: %{customdata[1]} yrs<extra></extra>"
    };

    const sRows = getSummaryRows(activeAge, sexName);
    const recRow = sRows.find(r => r.catIdx === 2);
    const estLabel =
      activeEst === "unweighted"
        ? "Sample Median (Exact 95% CI)"
        : "NHANES Survey-Weighted Median (95% CI)";

    const refTrace = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "lines",
      name: sexName + " 7–8h Benchmark",
      xaxis: "x" + axisSuffix,
      yaxis: "y" + axisSuffix,
      x: [-0.44, 3.44],
      y: recRow ? [recRow.med, recRow.med] : [null, null],
      line: {
        color: "rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.42)",
        width: 1.5,
        dash: "dash"
      },
      hoverinfo: "skip",
      showlegend: false
    };

    const medTrace = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "markers",
      name: axisSuffix === "" ? estLabel : estLabel + " (" + sexName + ")",
      showlegend: axisSuffix === "",
      xaxis: "x" + axisSuffix,
      yaxis: "y" + axisSuffix,
      x: sRows.map(r => r.catIdx),
      y: sRows.map(r => r.med),
      customdata: sRows.map(r => [
        SHORT_CATS[r.catIdx],
        r.n.toLocaleString(),
        r.lo.toFixed(1),
        r.hi.toFixed(1),
        r.unwMed.toFixed(1),
        r.wtdMed.toFixed(1)
      ]),
      error_y: {
        type: "data",
        symmetric: false,
        array: sRows.map(r => Number((r.hi - r.med).toFixed(2))),
        arrayminus: sRows.map(r => Number((r.med - r.lo).toFixed(2))),
        visible: true,
        color: "#ffffff",
        thickness: 2.3,
        width: 6
      },
      marker: {
        symbol: "diamond",
        size: 10.5,
        color: "#ffffff",
        line: { color: "#050811", width: 2 }
      },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>" + sexName + " &middot; %{customdata[0]}</b> (n = %{customdata[1]})<br>" +
        estLabel + ": <b>%{y:.1f} kg</b> [95% CI: %{customdata[2]}–%{customdata[3]} kg]<br>" +
        "Sample Median: %{customdata[4]} kg &middot; Survey-Weighted Median: %{customdata[5]} kg<extra></extra>"
    };

    const tickText = sRows.map(
      r =>
        SHORT_CATS[r.catIdx] +
        "<br><span style='font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8'>n = " +
        r.n.toLocaleString() +
        "</span>"
    );

    return {
      traces: [cloudTrace, refTrace, medTrace],
      tickText: tickText,
      count: xArr.length
    };
  }

  function renderHomepagePlot() {
    const malePanel = buildPanelTraces(0, "Male", "#38bdf8", "");
    const femalePanel = buildPanelTraces(1, "Female", "#f472b6", "2");

    const mHdr = getHeaderStat(activeAge, "Male");
    const fHdr = getHeaderStat(activeAge, "Female");
    const shownN = malePanel.count + femalePanel.count;
    const pctShown = ((shownN / TOTAL_N) * 100).toFixed(1);

    const badgeMethod = document.getElementById("active-method-badge");
    if (activeEst === "unweighted") {
      badgeMethod.className = "method-badge badge-descriptive";
      badgeMethod.textContent = "Unweighted Individual Observations + Exact Sample Medians (95% CI)";
    } else {
      badgeMethod.className = "method-badge badge-weighted";
      badgeMethod.textContent = "Unweighted Individual Points + NHANES Survey-Weighted Population Medians (95% CI)";
    }

    const ageLabel = activeAge === "ALL" ? "All Ages 16–80+" : "Ages " + activeAge;
    document.getElementById("active-sample-badge").textContent =
      ageLabel + " · Displaying n = " + shownN.toLocaleString() + " of " + TOTAL_N.toLocaleString() + " (" + pctShown + "%)";

    const medKindShort = activeEst === "unweighted" ? "Sample Median" : "Weighted Median";

    const layout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 54, r: 22, b: 76, l: 66 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: {
        domain: [0, 0.47],
        range: [-0.52, 3.52],
        tickvals: [0, 1, 2, 3],
        ticktext: malePanel.tickText,
        tickfont: { size: 11.5, color: "#e2e8f0" },
        title: { text: "Nightly Sleep Duration Category (with Male Subgroup n)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" }, standoff: 14 },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.10)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        range: [5, 176],
        title: { text: "Combined Bilateral Grip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      xaxis2: {
        domain: [0.53, 1.0],
        anchor: "y2",
        range: [-0.52, 3.52],
        tickvals: [0, 1, 2, 3],
        ticktext: femalePanel.tickText,
        tickfont: { size: 11.5, color: "#e2e8f0" },
        title: { text: "Nightly Sleep Duration Category (with Female Subgroup n)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" }, standoff: 14 },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.10)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis2: {
        anchor: "x2",
        matches: "y",
        range: [5, 176],
        showticklabels: true,
        tickfont: { color: "#94a3b8" },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      annotations: [
        {
          xref: "paper",
          yref: "paper",
          x: 0.235,
          y: 1.08,
          xanchor: "center",
          yanchor: "bottom",
          showarrow: false,
          text:
            "<b style='color:#7dd3fc;font-size:13.5px'>MALES</b> <span style='color:#cbd5e1;font-size:12.5px'>(n = " +
            mHdr.n.toLocaleString() +
            " &middot; " +
            medKindShort +
            " " +
            mHdr.med.toFixed(1) +
            " kg)</span>"
        },
        {
          xref: "paper",
          yref: "paper",
          x: 0.765,
          y: 1.08,
          xanchor: "center",
          yanchor: "bottom",
          showarrow: false,
          text:
            "<b style='color:#f9a8d4;font-size:13.5px'>FEMALES</b> <span style='color:#cbd5e1;font-size:12.5px'>(n = " +
            fHdr.n.toLocaleString() +
            " &middot; " +
            medKindShort +
            " " +
            fHdr.med.toFixed(1) +
            " kg)</span>"
        }
      ],
      legend: {
        orientation: "h",
        x: 0,
        y: -0.18,
        font: { color: "#e2e8f0", size: 12 }
      }
    };

    const allTraces = malePanel.traces.concat(femalePanel.traces);
    Plotly.react("home-flagship-plot", allTraces, layout, {
      responsive: true,
      displaylogo: false,
      modeBarButtonsToRemove: ["lasso2d", "select2d"]
    });
  }

  window.setHomeAge = function (ageVal) {
    activeAge = ageVal;
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-age]").forEach(btn => {
      btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.getAttribute("data-age") === ageVal);
    });
    renderHomepagePlot();
  };

  window.setHomeEstimate = function (estMode) {
    activeEst = estMode;
    document.getElementById("est-unweighted").classList.toggle("active", estMode === "unweighted");
    document.getElementById("est-weighted").classList.toggle("active", estMode === "weighted");
    renderHomepagePlot();
  };

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    renderHomepagePlot();
  });
})();
</script>
```
